name: Review Showcase for TikTok
author: Maidul

sections.description:
Review Showcase for TikTok lets you show TikTok videos as customer testimonials on your pages, in a carousel or a grid. For each video you paste TikTok’s embed code, add a star rating and, if you want, a button with a link.

It does not fetch videos from TikTok, hashtags or accounts. You add each video yourself.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by TikTok.

Features

  • Add videos as “TikTok Reviews” and show them with the shortcode [tiktok_review_showcase]
  • Carousel (Swiper) or grid layout
  • Optional star rating and button for each video
  • Choose which reviews to show with ids, limit, orderby and order

Shortcode Attributes

Use the [tiktok_review_showcase] shortcode with optional attributes to customize the display of TikTok video testimonials:

  • ids — Comma-separated list of specific review post IDs to display. Example: ids="1,2,3"
  • limit — Number of reviews to show if ids is not specified. Default: 6
  • orderby — Field to sort reviews by. Options include date, title, etc. Default: date
  • order — Sort order, either ASC or DESC. Default: DESC
  • class — Add custom CSS classes to the wrapper element for styling
  • layout — Choose layout style: carousel (default) or grid
  • show_rating — Display star ratings: true (default) or false
  • show_cta — Show call-to-action button: true (default) or false

Example Usage

[tiktok_review_showcase layout="grid" limit="6" show_rating="true" show_cta="false"]<h3>External Services</h3>

This plugin loads TikTok’s embed script, https://www.tiktok.com/embed.js, in the visitor’s browser on single posts and pages so that the TikTok videos you added can play. When it loads, the visitor’s browser connects to TikTok, which receives standard request data such as the visitor’s IP address and may set or read its own cookies, as described in TikTok’s policies.

  • TikTok
  • Terms of Service: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/row/privacy-policy/en

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by TikTok.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data from users directly.

However, embedded TikTok videos may collect usage data as per TikTok’s own privacy policy. Please review their privacy policy for more information.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open TikTok Reviews in your dashboard to add TikTok video testimonials.
  4. Use the shortcode [tiktok_review_showcase] on a page to display them.
sections.faq:
Can I load videos from a hashtag or an account?

No. You paste each video’s embed code (the Embed button on the TikTok video page).

Can I use other platforms?

No, TikTok only.

Can I customize the call-to-action buttons?

Yes, you can easily customize the CTA buttons by specifying the label and URL when adding or editing each TikTok video review in the WordPress dashboard, allowing you to tailor calls to action for maximum engagement.

Is this plugin optimized for mobile devices?

The layouts are responsive, and the carousel uses Swiper.js, which supports touch navigation.
